page.title: Mission Samudra
page.subtitle: Kerala Maritime Development Roadmap 2026–2035
page.description: A phased programme covering Vizhinjam, major and minor ports, maritime clusters, policy, governance, social inclusion and green maritime transition.

activities.manifestoDeclaration: #346: "Steps will be taken to attract investors through PPP models. Tourism, Agriculture, IT and Wellness will be the main focus areas." Mission Samudra rationale: All four PPP focus sectors have a maritime dimension: tourism (cruise), agriculture (plantation exports), IT (maritime SaaS/BPO), wellness (medical tourism). Zero state expenditure model. #677: "A single-window clearance system will be implemented to start new ventures." Mission Samudra rationale: Faster approvals and execution. #678: "An investment protection law will be implemented to provide confidence and commitment to private investors." Mission Samudra rationale: Investment protection law = the enabling condition that makes the Vizhinjam corridor investable for private capital. Directly addresses Kerala's historical reputation problem on investor-state disputes.

activities.manifestoDeclaration: #610: "The government will provide assistance to establish deep-freeze units to preserve fish in the fishing sector." Mission Samudra rationale: Deep-freeze at landing centres → cold chain corridor → Processing Park. Solves the post-catch deterioration problem that forces Kerala processors to sell domestically at low prices. #588: "Seafood processing parks and cold chain facilities will be established." Mission Samudra rationale: Core industrial output of fisheries cluster. Port-side cold chain + 1,000 reefer plugs at various location that moves frozen shrimp exports from Visakhapatnam back to Kerala.

activities.manifestoDeclaration: #576: "The package announced by the previous UDF government to address the impacts on fishermen due to the Vizhinjam project will be implemented." Mission Samudra rationale: Active participation of fisherman community in skilling, employment. #573: "Steps will be taken to form self-help groups for women in the fishing sector for self-employment and to provide them with necessary guidelines, training and materials." Mission Samudra rationale: Women SHGs → IQF processing units → Seafood processing park supply chain. Replicates the MPEDA Andhra Pradesh model in Kerala coastal villages. 3× higher realisation per tonne vs raw fish. #604: "A special committee including fishermen and experts will be formed to study the impacts of the blue economy and necessary steps will be taken based on the report." Mission Samudra rationale: Policy research arm for Mission Samudra's coastal expansion. Ensures port-based development integrates fishermen as beneficiaries, not displaced communities.

activities.manifestoDeclaration: #726: "Steps will be taken to make Kerala a leading cruise ship destination." Mission Samudra rationale: Vizhinjam ICP status gazetted Nov 2025 makes this immediately actionable. Target: 80–150 cruise calls/year. Kovalam + backwater circuit, See Kerala – GoK sponsored tour packages. #721: "Plans will be implemented to transform Kerala into a destination for adventure, wellness, medical, sports and farm tourism." Mission Samudra rationale: More cruises. #349: "A School of Hospitality will be launched to train professionals to provide better service to tourists." Mission Samudra rationale: Crew change at Vizhinjam (ICP live) + cruise tourism + medical tourism = major hospitality workforce demand. School of Hospitality at Kovalam/Trivandrum feeds this pipeline directly.
